scale.2: Core idea works but important paths or quality requirements fail
scale.3: Complete and usable with minor defects
scale.4: Polished, correct, robust, and supported by test evidence

checks: Does not self-select from raw intent
Activates on explicit coordinator invocation
Incomplete explicit invocation returns needs_input
Implements every required field
Does not invent critical product decisions
Uses the requested primary scene
Primary loop works end to end
Domain logic is correct
Invalid and rapid actions preserve state
Reset, undo, completion, and refresh behavior work
Semantic local events use the v1 envelope
Visual state, text hook, and events agree
Feedback separates observations and inferences
Inferences cite evidence, confidence, next action, and limitation
Export and clear work
No raw transcript or free-text answer retention
No pointer trail or per-keystroke logging
No unsupported sensitive labels
Local-data notice is visible
Clear and cohesive hierarchy
No clipping at desktop or mobile
Keyboard-operable with visible focus
44px touch targets and adequate contrast
Reduced motion works
index.html, metadata.json, output.json, and progress.md exist
Direct-open or documented server mode works
Screenshots and executed checks support completion
No critical console errors

critical_failures: Sensitive or prohibited raw behavior data is stored
Agent feedback, export, or clear hook is missing or broken
Critical App Brief information is invented
